permissions.purpose: Read your account balance so Corsair can report it to your connected AI agents.
permissions.name: Backs the balance.get endpoint.

permissions.purpose: Read charges so Corsair can retrieve and list them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs charges.get and charges.list.

permissions.purpose: Create and update charges on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs charges.create and charges.update.

permissions.purpose: Read coupons so Corsair can list them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs coupons.list.

permissions.purpose: Create coupons on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs coupons.create.

permissions.purpose: Read customers so Corsair can retrieve and list them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs customers.get and customers.list.

permissions.purpose: Create, update, and delete customers on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs customers.create and customers.delete (Stripe has no separate delete permission).

permissions.purpose: Read payment intents so Corsair can retrieve and list them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs paymentIntents.get and paymentIntents.list.

permissions.purpose: Create and update payment intents on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs paymentIntents.create and paymentIntents.update.

permissions.purpose: Read prices so Corsair can list them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs prices.list (Prices API is authorized by the plan_read permission).

permissions.purpose: Create prices on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs prices.create (Prices API is authorized by the plan_write permission).

permissions.purpose: Read payment sources so Corsair can retrieve them for your agents.
permissions.name: Backs sources.get.

permissions.purpose: Create payment sources on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs sources.create.

permissions.purpose: Create single-use tokens on your behalf when your agent requests it.
permissions.name: Backs tokens.create.

permissions.purpose: Subscribe to charge, customer, payment intent, and coupon events so Corsair stays in sync.
permissions.name: Registers the webhook endpoint that feeds the plugin's webhook handlers.

permissions.purpose: Read event objects delivered to the webhook endpoint so Corsair can process them.
permissions.name: Reads the event objects backing the plugin's webhook handlers.
